speaker: alse_pinder
text: It will stick. I told you at the bowl. Lift, then push, and do not call it a fault worth a workman.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am lifting. I am not calling anyone. A Wednesday night is a poor reason to mend a door that already knows my hand.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Your candle is the short one. The hall keeps its own. She can see a light from her bed. Do not give her two, or she will think you have opened a shop.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One. I have a leaf in mind, and a bundle I am not opening. If the light goes out, I was done.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then be done when you are done. I am not coming up. The crabs are finished, and so is my errand.
